name: Human Hemoglobin Subunit Beta (HBB)
description: Essential tetrameric oxygen carrier in human erythrocytes. Contains proximal and distal histidine residues coordinating the heme iron.

name: Hen Egg White Lysozyme C (LYSC)
description: Innate antibacterial defense enzyme hydrolyzing peptidoglycan 1,4-beta-linkages. Features an N-terminal secretory signal peptide and 4 disulfide bridges.

name: Human Insulin Precursor (INS)
description: Major metabolic regulator controlling glucose uptake. Synthesized as preproinsulin, cleaved into A and B chains linked by disulfide bonds.

name: Bovine Rhodopsin (RHO)
description: Canonical 7-transmembrane helical photopigment required for dim-light vision. Covalently binds 11-cis-retinal via a protonated Schiff base at Lys-296.

name: Green Fluorescent Protein (GFP)
description: Bioluminescent energy transfer acceptor from Aequorea victoria. Spontaneously forms an internal 4-(p-hydroxybenzylidene)-5-imidazolinone chromophore.

name: Yeast Cytochrome c Iso-1 (CYC1)
description: Mitochondrial intermembrane space electron carrier between complex III and complex IV in the respiratory chain. Covalently attaches heme via Cys-19 and Cys-22.
